title: Move a story without changing its identity or links

steps.action: Link one story to another story before moving it.
steps.expected_result: The relation is current before the move.

steps.action: Move the linked story to another feature.
steps.expected_result: The package moves while the story URN and relation endpoints remain unchanged and current.
The request replays without duplicating or changing records.

expected_result: A moved story keeps its URN and every valid relation remains current in the destination feature.
